verdict.line: You lose if you let her land Hookshot off a wall into a free combo; you win if you force the all-in before she resets away with Q.

brief.thesis: Renekton's kit has a hard Fury threshold: past 50 Fury his W (Ruthless Predator) goes from a two-hit stun to a three-hit stun that strips shields, which is exactly what shreds Camille's passive Adaptive Defenses shield mid-trade. That mechanical edge is why Renekton holds lane advantage and the solo-kill edge here, but Camille's Q (Precision Protocol) delayed-recast scaling and Hookshot (E) knockup keep the head-to-head at a near-even 49.5% over 1504 games — she claws back what she loses in the early trades once she hits 6.

theirWindow.when: After she Hookshots off a wall near you
theirWindow.what: Camille's E (Hookshot) knocks you up on landing at up to 800 range; she'll chain that into W (Tactical Sweep) and an empowered Q (Precision Protocol) auto while you're locked down, and from level 6 on she can follow with R (The Hextech Ultimatum) to anchor you in place for the full combo.

yourWindow.when: Once your Fury is above 50 and E is up
yourWindow.what: Dash in with E (Slice and Dice) to close the gap, then land the empowered W (Ruthless Predator) — three slashes, 1.5s stun, and it destroys her passive shield outright — before she can get a Q recast off. Her E is on a 16-12s cooldown, so if she's already used Hookshot to reposition or farm, she has no knockup to save her.

start.why: Run in 82.4% of games at a 50.8% win rate — the extra sustain and AD feed your early Q (Cull the Meek) poke-and-heal pattern.

boots.why: Picked in 81.4% of games for a 52.2% win rate — Camille is an auto-attack-reliant AD threat, and the flat reduction blunts her Q-empowered and R-empowered autos.

core.why: First item in the most-played and best-performing path (55.6% win rate, 261 games) — spikes your burst right when you're already ahead in trades.
Second item in the same path — stacking armor shred compounds with your E's own armor reduction on empowered hits.
Closes out the top-performing core (55.6% over 261 games) — the extra sustain matters once Camille starts landing empowered Q autos and R magic damage on top of her basics.

situational.when: she's landing her full Hookshot-into-R combo on you and you need to survive burst instead of just outlasting it
you're already ahead and want to shorten your W and E cooldowns for a faster stun-lock chain in extended fights
you need to catch her Q-empowered movement speed bursts or chase down a losing Camille before she resets

runes.keystoneWhy: Run in the higher win-rate page (52.3%, 34.6% pick) — the stacking adaptive damage and healing directly offsets Camille's W (Tactical Sweep) self-heal and passive shield in a prolonged trade.

summoners.why: Flash + Ignite is run in 85.8% of games (50.2% win rate) and lines up with your solo-kill advantage — take it to close out level 3-5 all-ins before she can trade back. Flash + Teleport (12.6% pick, 49.3% win rate) is the fallback if you'd rather scale and stay relevant to sidelanes.

playing.title: Poke with Q on cooldown
playing.detail: Cull the Meek is only a 7s cooldown and heals you — throw it out whenever she's in your 325 range to stack Fury and offset her passive shield's sustain before she can even proc it twice.

playing.title: Save E for punishing her Q recast
playing.detail: Her Q (Precision Protocol) does its big damage if she delays the recast — dash in with Slice and Dice while she's holding that window open so she either whiffs it or takes the empowered W stun before it lands.

playing.title: Track her E before you commit
playing.detail: Hookshot is 16-12s on cooldown and only knocks up off a wall — if she's near a wall and it's up, don't extend your trade; wait for it to go on cooldown from farming or repositioning first.

playing.title: All-in the instant Fury crosses 50
playing.detail: Your W becomes a three-hit, 1.5s stun that destroys her passive shield outright — this is the single biggest swing point in the matchup, so track your own Fury bar over anything on her side.

playing.title: Respect her ultimate timer from level 6
playing.detail: The Hextech Ultimatum is 140/115/90s early — once you've seen her use it, you have a long window where she has no forced-engage tool, which is your best time to shove and all-in again.

playing.title: Don't fight into a fresh W (Tactical Sweep)
playing.detail: The outer half of her cone slows and deals extra damage while healing her — if she's just landed it on you, back off half a second rather than immediately trading through the heal.

brief.patchCaveat: Every item, rune, and summoner pick above comes from measured Renekton vs Camille games on the current patch (16.19.1) via OP.GG; the timing windows and mechanical reasoning are my own read on how the abilities interact.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of being hit with Camille’s (E). Use Renekton’s reinforced [W] to destroy the shield on (P) and to gain the upper hand.
